content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages enables digital creators to host their online stores for free, bypassing the need for conventional payment processors. This solution is crucial for creators in countries where services like PayPal and Gumroad are unavailable. By utilizing GitHub Pages, creators maintain full control over their products and sales process, ensuring that they are not dependent on third-party platforms that can impose fees or restrictions. This approach fosters true sovereignty in digital commerce.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of several components that work in unison. GitHub Pages provides the hosting, allowing creators to display their products. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, facilitating automated order processing. NOWPayments manages cryptocurrency transactions, enabling instant payment confirmations while charging only a 0.5% fee. This combination creates a robust system that is both reliable and cost-effective, ensuring creators can focus on their craft without worrying about payment processing complexities.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is tailored for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms fail to provide service. Artists, educators, and entrepreneurs in countries like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela can benefit from a system that enables them to sell ebooks, courses, and digital assets directly. By adopting this model, they not only circumvent the limitations imposed by conventional platforms but also retain full ownership of their sales process, ensuring maximum profitability.
Eliminate platform fees and retain more profit.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The primary components include GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, and NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. GitHub Pages makes it easy to set up a professional-looking storefront without any financial investment. Google Apps Script or Workers automate order fulfillment, while NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring creators can accept payments from a global audience. Together, these tools form a seamless ecosystem for digital commerce.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first set up a GitHub Pages account and create your product listings. Next, use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing and notifications. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions. Ensure that your product files are stored on a reliable cloud service for easy delivery. Each step allows you to build a fully operational store within a matter of hours, paving the way for immediate sales. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using GitHub Pages to host your digital product store. This approach eliminates the need for traditional payment processors while leveraging NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. With only a 0.5% fee, you retain more of your profits while ensuring a seamless purchasing experience for your customers.
Automate sales processes for a seamless customer experience.

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without relying on conventional platforms, GitHub Pages paired with NOWPayments is your solution. For further support, check the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the blueprints and templates you need. Discover more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account and set up your Pages site for free hosting. 2. Design your product pages with clear descriptions and images. 3. Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for order management. 4. Integrate NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments seamlessly. 5. Store your product files on a reliable cloud storage solution for streamlined delivery. 6. Test the entire system to ensure smooth transaction flows before launching.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by using GitHub Pages for free hosting and integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This setup allows you to bypass traditional payment platforms while maintaining control over your sales.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way is to host your digital downloads on GitHub Pages and utilize NOWPayments for payment processing. This combination significantly reduces fees compared to platforms like Gumroad while giving you full ownership of your product.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by creating a free online store on GitHub Pages and integrating it with NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This allows you to operate independently from those platforms.
How much can I save by using NOWPayments instead of Gumroad?
By using NOWPayments, you save significantly since they charge only 0.5% per transaction compared to Gumroad's 10%. For 100 sales of a $97 product, this difference can retain $921 in your pocket.
Can I automate product delivery with this setup?

Yes, you can automate product delivery by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage order fulfillment. This automation ensures your customers receive their products instantly after payment confirmation.
